title: KillSec ransomware group infrastructure dismantled in international operation
content_md:
📢 The infrastructure of the KillSec ransomware group was dismantled during an international operation. On October 1, 2026, the Federal Office of Police (fedpol) announced the action carried out on September 30, 2026.

via Mastodon https://cyberveille.ch/posts/2026-10-02-demantelement-de-l-infrastructure-du-groupe-ransomware-killsec-lors-d-une-operation-internationale/
